title: wg: virtual-clients-01 L1208 The state_transfer variant omits interim_transcript_hash (or the...
description:
draft-ietf-mls-virtual-clients (virtual-clients-01), State transfer protocol (HigherLevelGroupState). Editors' copy mlswg/mls-virtual-clients at 65e960d, L1208.

Text: "    case state_transfer:
      opaque init_secret<V>;"

Problem: The state_transfer variant omits interim_transcript_hash (or the current epoch's confirmation_tag), which the joiner needs to compute the next epoch's confirmed_transcript_hash. Without it, the joiner cannot create or verify the next Commit. Proposals already pending in the current epoch are also not transferred. The same struct is in -01.

Suggested fix: Add `opaque interim_transcript_hash<V>` (or the confirmation_tag) to the state_transfer case. Either transfer the current epoch's pending proposals or state where the joiner gets them.

Severity: high. Verifier: keep (Confirmed. RFC 9420 §8.2 computes interim_transcript_hash from confirmed_transcript_hash and the confirmation_tag. The GroupContext carries only confirmed_transcript_hash, and the state_transfer case (L1208-1219) carries neither the confirmation_tag nor the interim hash. L1057 names only the ratchet tree and GroupContext as what the joiner obtains. The pending-proposals gap is also real: proposals sent before the joiner was added never reach it.)

From MLS audit workflow wf_581e61f8-b25 (2026-10-21). Not yet reviewed by Mark; nothing posted upstream.
